title: Tomato and Spring Onion Omelette with Jalapeño Salsa
blurb: A fluffy omelette filled with spring onions, served with a fresh tomato and jalapeño salsa that adds a proper kick.
steps: Dice the tomatoes finely and deseed and finely chop the jalapeños, then mix them together in a small bowl with a pinch of salt to make the salsa.
Trim and finely slice the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts separate.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the water and a pinch each of salt and pepper, then beat well with a fork until combined.
Heat half the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add the white parts of the spring onions, cooking for one minute until softened.
Pour in half the egg mixture and let it settle for a few seconds, then gently push the edges towards the centre with a spatula, tilting the pan so uncooked egg flows to the edges.
When the omelette is nearly set but still slightly wet on top, scatter over half the green spring onion parts and fold the omelette in half.
Slide onto a warm plate and repeat with the remaining oil, egg mixture and spring onions to make the second omelette.
Serve the omelettes with the fresh salsa spooned over the top.
